IS 19901 : 2026 Safe Handling of Biotherapeutic Products Used in Homoeopathy - Guidelines

ICS 03.100.70, 07.100.01, 11.100.01

AYD 07

1 SCOPE

This standard covers the guidelines for the safe handling, preparation, documentation, regulation and safety evaluation of biotherapeutic products used in homoeopathy, ensuring protection of personnel, the public and the environment. It also provides guidelines for risk assessment, biosafety classification, containment procedures and quality assurance throughout the processing of biotherapeutic materials for therapeutic use in homoeopathy.

2 REFERENCES

The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute the provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
